title: AWS Parameter Store: PushSecret metadata structure changed to `PushSecretMetadata`

detection.reason: the store a PushSecret pushes to is a reference; the projection carries each data entry's metadata FORMAT, not the provider behind its store

quote: https://github.com/external-secrets/external-secrets/pull/4262 introduces a breaking change in the METADATA structure for the AWS PARAMETER STORE.
remediation: For each PushSecret named whose store is AWS Parameter Store, rewrite `spec.data[].metadata` in the `apiVersion: kubernetes.external-secrets.io/v1alpha1`, `kind: PushSecretMetadata` form (secretType, kmsKeyID, tier, tags under `spec`) before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pushsecrets.external-secrets.io,clusterpushsecrets.external-secrets.io -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select(any((.spec.data // .spec.pushSecretSpec.data // [])[]; .metadata != null and .metadata.kind != "PushSecretMetadata")) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace // "-")/\(.metadata.name) stores=\([(.spec.secretStoreRefs // .spec.pushSecretSpec.secretStoreRefs // [])[].name] | join(","))"'  # each row pushes metadata in the old format
